final_decision.minimal_fix: Collect the three local phase durations into a long[3], reduce them elementwise with MPI_Reduce using MPI_LONG and MPI_MAX, and have rank 0 print the sum of the three reduced phase maxima. Retain the existing completion synchronization.
final_decision.semantic_equivalence_basis: A global-makespan equivalence is disproved by the independent first useful computation. Initialization supplies replicated geometry and disjoint nonempty row partitions before timing. computeTimeDelays immediately performs numerical work without communication; the first subsequent collective gathers form-factor row counts only after additional independent culling work. Final barriers establish completion boundaries, but no dependency establishes that rank 0's starts precede all relevant work. Summing sequential phase durations is permissible only when those phase durations are globally valid.
final_decision.notes: The supplied target-platform probe establishes that the millisecond count expressions have type long on this unchanged LP64 toolchain, supporting MPI_LONG for the proposed fix and the existing %ld formatting. Whole-millisecond truncation is not a defect. Initialization and RNG setup outside the phase timers are permitted by the contract.
